description: Check an existing deposit booking on your signed-in Direct account: reconcile its Stripe Checkout payment and return its receipt and the separate booking state. Use it after send_to_business returned a payment_url for a deposit booking, to see whether the person has paid; it cannot start a payment, which the person makes on Stripe’s hosted page. Pass biz (the business id from its card) and task_id (the task id send_to_business returned for that booking). Requires direct:tasks. Uses only the stored merchant account and amount and creates no new charge or booking identity; a verified paid checkout may finish its already-authorized held booking. Payout status remains unknown: paid does not mean a bank payout. Safe to repeat.

biz.description: The business id (from its card) the deposit booking was made with.

task_id.description: The task id send_to_business returned for that booking.

name: get_direct_payment
title: Check your merchant checkout and booking
